sentences.text: accused persons Jitendra @ Jitendra Kumar Gupta, Babita, Jeet Singh and Leena Singh have been granted interim protection by this Court as well as coordinate Bench of this Court, copy of which are on record as Annexure No. 12 to the application.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that against the applicant investigation is still pending.
Applicant is 73 years old.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is not a previous convict; he has no criminal antecedents and he undertakes to cooperate in the investigation.
Learned Addl. Government Advocate prays for and is allowed three weeks time to file counter affidavit.
List on 11.07.2023 after connecting with Criminal Misc. Anticipatory Bail Application U/S 438 Cr.P.C. Nos. 586/2023, 792/2023, 847/2023 and 856/2023.

On due consideration to the orders passed in the cases of co-accused persons, so also the fact that the applicant is 73 years old; he applicant has no criminal history and the applicant is undertaking to cooperate in the investigation as also the judgment of Apex Court passed in Sushila Aggarwal and others versus State (NCT of Delhi) and another (2020)5 SCC 1, it would be appropriate to grant interim protection to the applicant under Section 438 Cr.P.C.
Till the next date of listing, it is provided that in the event of arrest, the applicant shall be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond and two sureties of the like amount to the satisfaction of the arresting officer/I.O./S.H.O. concerned.

sentences.text: The applicant shall cooperate in the investigation and he will not influence the witness.
The accused-applicant will remain present as and when the arresting officer/I.O./S.H.O. concerned call(s) for investigation/interrogation.
The applicant shall not leave India without previous permission of the Court.

In case of default, it would be open for the investigating agency to move application for vacation of this interim protection.?
3.

Although a counter affidavit has been filed, nothing has come to light which may persuade this Court to take a view, different from the view taken while passing the aforesaid order, nor the learned A.G.A. has pointed out violation of any of the conditions of interim anticipatory bail committed by the applicant.
4. In view of the aforesaid circumstances, the interim order dated 15.05.2023 is hereby made absolute and the application is allowed in terms of the aforesaid order.
5. In case, the applicant has not furnished bail bonds, he shall appear before the trial court and submit bail bonds within a period of two weeks from today.
